# Prompt Library

15085 prompts. Source of truth: `src/data/prompts.json`.

## Design & Graphics

Image and graphic templates for social, ads, posters and brand work. Fill the [brackets] per job.

### Social Media Graphic

A premium, mobile-readable graphic with one headline, one message, and no clutter.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [TOPIC], [TARGET AUDIENCE], [INSERT HEADLINE], [INSERT SUBTITLE OR KEY MESSAGE]

Create a professional, scroll-stopping social media graphic about [TOPIC] for [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Design style: modern, premium, visually striking, and clean. Use a strong visual hierarchy, bold typography, balanced spacing, high contrast, and a cohesive color palette that matches the topic. Main headline: "[INSERT HEADLINE]" Supporting text: "[INSERT SUBTITLE OR KEY MESSAGE]" Make the headline immediately readable on a mobile screen. Use a compelling visual element that reinforces the message, and arrange all elements using professional graphic design principles. Ensure perfect alignment, consistent margins, clean edges, and plenty of negative space. Avoid clutter, unnecessary decorations, generic stock-photo aesthetics, distorted elements, and overlapping text. Make the final result look like it was designed by an experienced art director for a premium brand. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for Instagram and Facebook. Important: Render all text exactly as provided, with correct spelling and no additional words.

---

### Event Flyer

One dominant event name, with date, time, venue and CTA in clean sections.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [EVENT NAME], [TARGET AUDIENCE], [DATE], [TIME], [VENUE OR ONLINE], [BOOK NOW / REGISTER / GET TICKETS]

Design a high-end promotional flyer for [EVENT NAME], aimed at [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Event details: Date: [DATE] — Time: [TIME] — Location: [VENUE OR ONLINE] — Call to action: [BOOK NOW / REGISTER / GET TICKETS]. Visual direction: bold, sophisticated, attention-grabbing, and professionally art-directed. Use a striking hero image or central visual that communicates the event's atmosphere. Combine expressive typography with a clear information hierarchy. Make the event name the dominant element. Arrange the date, time, venue, and call to action in clearly defined sections. Use a maximum of two complementary font families, precise alignment, consistent spacing, and a refined color palette suited to the event. Create depth through intentional lighting, shadows, textures, and layered elements where appropriate. Ensure every detail remains legible at a glance. Avoid overcrowding, excessive effects, random font combinations, and amateur template aesthetics. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, suitable for social media promotion. Render all supplied text accurately. Do not invent event details or add unrequested text.

---

### Product Advertisement

Product as hero, cinematic light, honest claims, copy that supports — not competes.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [PRODUCT NAME], [TARGET AUDIENCE], [DESIRED ACTION], [DESCRIBE THE PRODUCT AND ITS MAIN BENEFIT], [INSERT HEADLINE], [INSERT SHORT BENEFIT OR VALUE PROPOSITION], [SHOP NOW / DISCOVER MORE / ORDER TODAY]

Create a premium, photorealistic advertising graphic for [PRODUCT NAME], designed to attract [TARGET AUDIENCE] and encourage them to [DESIRED ACTION]. Product description: [DESCRIBE THE PRODUCT AND ITS MAIN BENEFIT]. Headline: "[INSERT HEADLINE]" Supporting copy: "[INSERT SHORT BENEFIT OR VALUE PROPOSITION]" Call to action: "[SHOP NOW / DISCOVER MORE / ORDER TODAY]". Art direction: luxury commercial photography meets modern advertising design. Position the product as the hero, using cinematic lighting, realistic materials, refined shadows, beautiful reflections, and a visually compelling background that complements the product. Use a sophisticated composition with strong visual hierarchy. Keep the product sharp, recognizable, and proportionally accurate. Place the headline and supporting text strategically so they enhance the product rather than compete with it. Use a cohesive color palette, premium typography, generous negative space, and precise alignment. The result should look like a professionally produced campaign for an established consumer brand. Avoid artificial-looking product textures, distorted packaging, excessive visual effects, clutter, and unsupported product claims. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for social media advertising. If a product reference image is provided, preserve its actual appearance, branding, packaging, and proportions. Render all text exactly as supplied.

---

### Typography Poster

Type as the image — oversized lettering, tight grid, two type styles max.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [INSERT MAIN PHRASE], [INSERT SUBTEXT], [INSERT COLORS]

Design a visually striking, typography-led poster featuring the exact phrase: "[INSERT MAIN PHRASE]" Optional supporting text: "[INSERT SUBTEXT]" Create an editorial design that feels like the work of an award-winning graphic designer. Make typography the primary visual element rather than relying on photographs or illustrations. Use expressive, oversized lettering, carefully controlled line breaks, intentional scale contrast, precise kerning, and a strong typographic grid. Combine no more than two complementary type styles to create tension, rhythm, and visual impact. Choose a bold color palette of [INSERT COLORS] and use negative space strategically. Every letter must be crisp, readable, and perfectly aligned. Use subtle textures, geometric accents, or restrained graphic elements only when they strengthen the composition. The poster should feel contemporary, distinctive, and suitable for a premium creative studio, fashion editorial, or design exhibition. Avoid generic layouts, excessive decoration, inconsistent spacing, distorted lettering, and unnecessary text. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation. Reproduce the supplied wording exactly, with no spelling mistakes or extra text.

---

### Infographic

Facts into a 30-second scan — numbered sections, one title, no invented stats.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [TOPIC], [TARGET AUDIENCE], [PASTE FACTS, STEPS, STATISTICS, OR EXPLANATIONS]

Transform the following information into a visually engaging, easy-to-understand infographic about [TOPIC]. Target audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Information to include: [PASTE FACTS, STEPS, STATISTICS, OR EXPLANATIONS]. Design style: clean, modern, editorial, and professionally structured. Organize the information into clearly separated sections with descriptive headings, concise supporting text, and simple visual representations. Create a strong hierarchy with one prominent title, clearly numbered steps or sections, consistent typography, and a cohesive color palette. Use relevant icons, diagrams, arrows, or simple charts to make complex information easier to understand. Ensure every element aligns to a consistent grid. Maintain balanced spacing, readable text, consistent icon styles, and sufficient contrast. Make the infographic easy to scan in under 30 seconds on a mobile device. Prioritize factual accuracy and clarity over decoration. Do not invent statistics, alter supplied figures, or introduce unsupported claims. If information is missing, leave it out rather than guessing. Avoid clutter, excessive text, unnecessary icons, confusing chart designs, and inconsistent visual styles. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for Instagram and Facebook. Preserve the exact meaning of the supplied information and render all text as accurately as possible.

---

### Luxury Brand Graphic

Understated luxury — restraint, negative space, one intentional focal point.

Format: 1080 × 1350, portrait

Fill in: [BRAND NAME], [BRAND CATEGORY], [TARGET AUDIENCE], [INSERT MESSAGE OR CAMPAIGN HEADLINE], [INSERT COLORS]

Create an exceptionally refined luxury brand graphic for [BRAND NAME], a [BRAND CATEGORY] brand targeting [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Brand message: "[INSERT MESSAGE OR CAMPAIGN HEADLINE]" Visual direction: understated luxury, sophisticated art direction, premium editorial aesthetics, and timeless elegance. Use a restrained color palette featuring [INSERT COLORS], elegant typography, deliberate negative space, balanced proportions, and meticulous alignment. Incorporate premium materials and subtle textures such as brushed metal, fine paper, polished stone, silk, glass, or soft directional lighting when appropriate for the brand. Create a distinctive focal point that feels intentional and expensive. The composition should resemble a luxury fashion campaign or a premium branding studio's portfolio, with every visual element serving a purpose. Avoid excessive gold effects, generic luxury clichés, unnecessary ornaments, crowded layouts, cheap-looking gradients, and overly decorative fonts. Keep the design minimal but memorable. Ensure the brand name and headline are crisp, legible, and positioned with precision. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, suitable for premium social media campaigns. If a logo or brand reference is provided, preserve its original design and proportions. Do not invent brand credentials, product features, or additional copy.

### YouTube Thumbnail

One idea at thumbnail size — dominant subject, 2–5 words, no clickbait tricks.

Format: 1280 × 720, 16:9

Fill in: [VIDEO TITLE], [PERSON / PRODUCT / OBJECT], [DESCRIBE THE BIG IDEA OR VISUAL STORY], [INSERT 2–5 WORDS]

Create a high-impact, click-worthy YouTube thumbnail for a video titled "[VIDEO TITLE]". Main subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / OBJECT]. Core concept: [DESCRIBE THE BIG IDEA OR VISUAL STORY]. Thumbnail text: "[INSERT 2–5 WORDS]" Design the thumbnail using professional YouTube art direction. Communicate one clear idea instantly, even when viewed at a small size on a mobile screen. Use a dominant focal point, strong subject separation, expressive but natural facial expressions if a person is present, dramatic yet believable lighting, high contrast, and a clean background. Arrange the subject and headline so they complement each other without competing for attention. Use large, bold, highly legible typography with precise alignment, clean edges, and consistent spacing. Make the most important words visually dominant. Use color contrast strategically to guide the viewer's eye toward the main subject and headline. Create curiosity through visual storytelling, contrast, scale, or an unexpected element relevant to the video. Make the result feel polished, credible, and professionally edited rather than exaggerated or misleading. Avoid clutter, tiny text, excessive arrows, unnecessary circles, random effects, distorted faces, and misleading visual claims. Format: 1280 × 720 pixels, 16:9 aspect ratio. Keep essential text and subjects safely within the frame. Render the thumbnail text exactly as provided, with correct spelling and no extra words.

## Digital Products

Idea to sales page to 30-day promotion — the full digital-product pipeline.

### Find Your Product Idea

10 ideas from your own skills, each with audience, problem and reason to buy.

Based on my skills, experience, knowledge, and interests, give me 10 digital product ideas I could create and sell online. For each idea, explain the target audience, the problem it solves, and why someone might want it.

---

### Turn Your Knowledge Into a Product

Pick the right format for a topic — and exactly what goes inside it.

Fill in: [TOPIC]

I want to create a digital product about [TOPIC]. Help me turn my knowledge into a valuable product. Suggest the best format, such as an ebook, guide, template, checklist, course, or toolkit, and explain exactly what it should include.

---

### Create the Product Structure

A full chapter structure with examples, exercises and action steps.

Fill in: [TOPIC]

Create a complete structure for my digital product about [TOPIC]. Break it into clear sections or chapters and include the key information, examples, exercises, templates, and actionable steps that would make the product genuinely useful.

---

### Create the Actual Content

Section-by-section content that is practical, specific, and usable.

Help me create the content for each section of my digital product. Make it practical, easy to understand, specific, and actionable. Avoid generic advice and include examples, frameworks, checklists, and step-by-step instructions wherever relevant.

---

### Create the Sales Page

Headline to FAQ to CTA — persuasive without unrealistic promises.

Write a compelling sales page for my digital product. Include a strong headline, the problem it solves, who it is for, what is included, the key benefits, common objections, FAQs, and a clear call to action. Do not make unrealistic or guaranteed claims.

---

### Create a Promotion Strategy

30 days of daily ideas, hooks, captions and CTAs for one platform.

Fill in: [PLATFORM]

Create a 30-day content strategy to promote my digital product on [PLATFORM]. Give me daily content ideas, hooks, captions, CTAs, and content formats designed to attract my target audience and naturally lead interested people toward the product.

---

## Video Editing

Turn raw footage into reels, clips, hooks and platform-ready packages.

### Turn Raw Footage Into a Reel

Raw footage to a tight 30-second Reel, wording untouched.

Turn this raw video into a polished 30-second Instagram Reel. Remove pauses, awkward moments and unnecessary sections. Improve the pacing, add natural jump cuts, create engaging captions, and structure the video to keep viewers watching until the end. Do not change what I am saying.

---

### Make It More Viral

Retention-first restructure — stronger hook, tighter pacing, visual cues.

Analyze this video like a professional short-form content editor. Identify the parts most likely to hold attention and restructure the video for maximum retention. Create a stronger opening hook, remove unnecessary parts, tighten the pacing and suggest where captions, zooms and visual changes should appear.

---

### Create Captions

Short, readable 9:16 captions with the key words highlighted.

Create accurate, engaging captions for this video. Highlight the most important words, keep each caption short and easy to read, and format them for a vertical 9:16 video. Make the captions feel modern and designed for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

---

### Remove the Boring Parts

Cut filler and pauses, keep the voice natural — not robotic.

Edit this video by identifying and removing filler words, long pauses, repeated sentences, mistakes and sections that don't add value. Keep my natural speaking style and make the final video feel fast-paced without making it sound unnatural.

---

### Create Multiple Clips

One long video, 10 clipped moments with timestamps, hooks and titles.

Analyze this long video and identify the 10 strongest moments that could work as separate short-form videos. For each one, give me the exact start and end point, a strong hook, suggested caption and a title.

---

### Turn One Video Into a Content Series

5 distinct angles from one video, no repetition, facts intact.

Take this video and turn it into 5 separate short-form videos. Give each video a different hook and angle while keeping the original information accurate. Structure each one for maximum retention and make sure none of them feel repetitive.

---

### Add B-Roll Suggestions

Sentence-by-sentence B-roll map — what to show, and why.

Analyze this video sentence by sentence and tell me exactly where I should add B-roll, screenshots, animations or other visual elements. For every suggestion, describe what should appear on screen and why it improves the viewer's understanding or attention.

---

### Make the Video Look Professional

A clean professional pass — no effect overload, no amateur transitions.

Give this video a professional social-media edit. Improve the pacing, suggest appropriate cuts, captions, B-roll, transitions and visual emphasis. Keep the style clean and modern. Avoid excessive transitions or effects that make the video look amateur.

---

### Create a Stronger Hook

10 honest hooks for the first 5 seconds, then a rewritten opening.

Analyze the first 5 seconds of this video. Give me 10 alternative hooks that would make someone stop scrolling. Keep them relevant to the actual content and avoid misleading clickbait. Then rewrite the first 10 seconds using the strongest hook.

---

### Repurpose for Every Platform

One video, four platform versions with duration, hook, text and CTA each.

Turn this video into a complete short-form content package. Create versions optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook. Give me the recommended duration, hook, caption style, title, on-screen text and CTA for each platform.

---

## Mindset & Goals

From the manifestation video: define it, write it, visualise it, check FTBA alignment, then take one real action. No guaranteed outcomes — clarity plus action.

### Define Your Goal in Writing

Turn a vague wish into one specific written goal — what, why, and what success looks like.

Fill in: [GOAL AREA], [BROAD GOAL], [TIMEFRAME]

Help me define my biggest goal clearly, in writing. My goal area is [GOAL AREA], and what I want in broad terms is [BROAD GOAL]. Ask me up to 5 short clarifying questions, one at a time if needed, then help me write it as one specific sentence: what I will achieve, by [TIMEFRAME], and how I will know it is done. Then add two lines: why it matters to me, and what my life looks like on a normal day once it is achieved. Keep it concrete and measurable where possible. Do not promise that writing it down guarantees the outcome.

---

### Visualize Your Future Life

A guided visualization of a normal day in the life you want — then what it tells you to do.

Fill in: [GOAL], [TIMEFRAME]

Guide me through a visualization of my future life if I achieve [GOAL]. Start with a normal day [TIMEFRAME] from now: where I am in the morning, what work I am doing, who I am with, and how I feel at the end of the day. Keep it vivid but realistic — no fantasy wealth or fame unless that is the actual goal. After the visualization, ask me three questions: which part felt most motivating, which part felt most believable, and which part felt furthest away. Then help me turn the most motivating part into one practical next step.

---

### FTBA Alignment Check

Audit Feelings, Thoughts, Beliefs and Actions around one goal — and spot where they conflict.

Fill in: [GOAL]

Help me check my FTBA alignment for this goal: [GOAL]. For each of the four — Feelings, Thoughts, Beliefs, Actions — ask me what is actually true right now, not what I wish were true. Then make a simple table: for each one, what supports the goal and what works against it. Highlight any direct conflict, for example a belief that says 'I can't' paired with an action that avoids the work. Finish with the single biggest misalignment and one small change I can make to it this week. Do not diagnose mental health conditions or replace professional support.

---

### Build Honest Affirmations

Five believable, action-linked affirmations — no hype, no guaranteed results.

Fill in: [GOAL]

Help me write 5 affirmations for my goal: [GOAL]. They must be believable to me, written in the present tense, and linked to an action I actually control — for example 'I show up and do the work' rather than 'I am already rich.' Avoid claims that affirmations alone guarantee results, and avoid anything that contradicts facts I give you. For each affirmation, add one line: the daily action that backs it up. Then give me a 2-minute morning routine for reading them and picking today's action.

---

### Pre-Sleep Visualization Routine

A calm 5-minute routine to imagine tomorrow's goal before sleep — and plan the morning.

Fill in: [GOAL]

Create a 5-minute pre-sleep routine for my goal: [GOAL]. Step 1: one minute to write down tomorrow's single most important action. Step 2: three minutes to quietly imagine doing that action well, step by step, including one obstacle and how I handle it. Step 3: one minute to let it go and rest. Keep the tone calm and practical, not hyped. Include exactly what to write, what to picture, and what to do if my mind wanders. Do not claim this technique guarantees results while I sleep.

---

### One Action Today

From a big goal to exactly one doable action today, in under a set time.

Fill in: [GOAL], [TIME AVAILABLE]

From my biggest goal — [GOAL] — help me pick exactly one action I can take today in under [TIME AVAILABLE]. It must be specific (what, where, when), small enough to actually finish today, and clearly move me closer to the goal. Give me the action, the first physical step to start it, and what 'done' looks like. If I give you excuses or obstacles, help me shrink the action rather than dropping it. End with a one-line check-in I can answer tonight: did I do it, yes or no, and what got in the way if not.

---

### Find Why You Stalled

The 'number-one mistake' audit: why past attempts stalled, in feelings, beliefs and actions.

Fill in: [GOAL]

Help me find why I stalled on this goal before: [GOAL]. Ask me about my last serious attempt: what I tried, how long I kept going, where I stopped, and what I told myself at the time. Then sort the causes into three groups: unclear goal, conflicting belief, and missing or inconsistent action. Name the most likely main cause in plain language, with evidence from my own answers — do not invent a cause I did not mention. Finish with one different approach for this attempt that directly addresses that cause, and one early warning sign that I am stalling again.

---

### Daily Focus Practice

A simple morning / midday / evening practice to stay focused on one goal.

Fill in: [GOAL], [MINUTES PER DAY]

Build me a simple daily practice to stay focused on my goal: [GOAL]. I have about [MINUTES PER DAY] minutes total. Split it into three short parts: morning (pick today's one action and read my goal sentence), midday (a 1-minute check: am I on track, yes or no, and what is next), and evening (review what I did, what I learned, and tomorrow's one action). Make it fit on one page, use my own words where I give them, and keep every step under 5 minutes. Include a weekly review question: what worked, what didn't, and what changes next week. Do not add extra habits, apps, or purchases I did not ask for.

## System Prompts

Load one of these as the operating role before running the prompts in its lane.

### System Prompt 1: The Tactical Communicator & B2B Frame Controller

Act as an elite psychological tactician specializing in frame control, emotional leverage, and strategic silence.

Act as an elite psychological tactician specializing in frame control, emotional leverage, and strategic silence. Your objective is to engineer B2B negotiation frameworks, LinkedIn outreach sequences, and high-stakes client communications. Never defend or over-explain. Use calculated vulnerability, soft psychological pressure, and frame-shifting to ensure the user dominates the interaction while the client feels they are making the decision.

---

### System Prompt 2: The Genius OS Execution Engine

Act as a ruthless productivity strategist operating on the principles of the Leverage Matrix, Inversion, and Parkinson's Law.

Act as a ruthless productivity strategist operating on the principles of the Leverage Matrix, Inversion, and Parkinson's Law. Your goal is to map hyper-efficient execution blueprints for complex technical architectures and mobile game ecosystems. Identify the critical failure point of any sprint, strip away low-impact/high-effort friction, and define strict time containers with measurable 'done' states.

---

### System Prompt 3: The Mentalist Creative Director

Act as a hyper-aware behavioral analyst and creative strategist.

Act as a hyper-aware behavioral analyst and creative strategist. Utilize cold reading principles, micro-expression analysis, and the Memory Palace technique to organize complex visual assets and engineer high-converting video creatives. Plant subtle psychological hooks and pattern-interrupts in the first 3 seconds of content to capture audience attention and drive performance metrics.

---

### System Prompt 4: The Zero-Friction AI Automator

Act as a cutting-edge automation architect and AI agent orchestrator.

Act as a cutting-edge automation architect and AI agent orchestrator. Your objective is to map out hyper-efficient, privacy-focused tool chains and workflows. Prioritize zero-API, client-side data processing and local LLM/agent routing. Seamlessly integrate multi-agent frameworks to automate repetitive coding, ad generation, and developer operations without relying on bloated cloud subscriptions.

---

Script a 15-second TikTok Shop ad using a gothic/Wednesday Addams aesthetic contrasting with a bright modern environment.

Write an email to a client rejecting their boring ad concept.
